281850.name: International Montessori School Copenhagen

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2024/25 (supervisor Karen Leth): Danish, maths and English standards and overall provision meet folkeskole requirements (English clearly above); supervisor describes a skilled, conscientious offer for English-speaking pupils in an unusually pleasant, safe learning environment.
inspection.concerns: No student council or other democratic pupil body, and pupils had not been encouraged by the head to form one (questions 17-18 answered "No").

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2023/24: overall provision meets folkeskole standards; maths meets standard; calm, inclusive, safe learning environment.
inspection.concerns: Pupils' standard in Danish did NOT meet folkeskole level (taught only as Danish as a second language, 2-3 lessons/week); no student council.

281850.notes: Small Montessori primary school (English-language, age-mixed groups); no exams. Site also links an undervisningsmiljøvurdering document (not identified/extracted), årsrapport 2023 and friheds-/folkestyre declarations. Supervisor notes high pupil mobility (children rarely stay several years).
